watch.summary: A streamer preaches positivity and promises not to threaten his egg avatar anymore, only to instantly whisper threats whenever it falls.

beats.what: Streamer claims he is now all about positivity and won't threaten the egg
The egg falls off the track
He instantly drops his calm demeanor to mutter a quiet threat
He immediately switches back to talking softly about spreading love and positivity
The egg falls off the track a second time
He laughs nervously and asks the egg if it is testing him

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Fall one more time. You see what the threat is, okay?
watch.why: The instant contrast between his gentle sermon about positivity and his dead-serious quiet threats creates great comedic irony. His ability to instantly switch between calm positivity and suppressed gamer rage delivers excellent comic timing.
